headline.title: A quiet Wednesday, pending paperwork
headline.quip: The archivist spotted a few headlines about offline systems, but couldn’t get the pages to open. Without a source, they’re filed under rumor, which is where the status pages usually put them too.
headline.summary: No disruption for November 25 could be verified to the archive’s standard. Search results pointed to several cyber incidents, but the archivist couldn’t open the original reports, so none is included.

reasons: Web search returned headlines of possible November 25 incidents (myColorado app cyberattack, FinCEN systems offline, a Guadeloupe hospital ransomware attack, Turnitin, Rackspace Spot), but the source pages could not be opened, so none met the verification bar.
The Guadeloupe hospital item involves patients and may deserve a factual-only entry if verified by the owner.
